# Libraries

```{r libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)

```

\newpage

# Load data

```{r data, message = FALSE}

# Load FDA approval data

fda_approvals <- read_csv(
    here(
        "processed_data/fda_approvals/fda_sdud_pdl_merged.csv"
        )
) |>
rename(
    approvals = n_approvals,
    firm = sponsor_name
    ) |>
mutate(post = approval_year >= 2014) |>
filter(approval_year >= 2010)

# Load patent data

patents <- read_csv(
    here(
        "processed_data/patents/patents_sdud_pdl_merged.csv"
    )
) |>
    rename(
        atc_level1 = ATC1,
        patents = num_patents) |>
    mutate(post = patent_year >= 2014) |>
    filter(patent_year >= 2010)


```

\newpage

# Between firm variation for ATCs

## FDA

```{r FDA_between, message = FALSE}

fda_firm_atc_prepost <- fda_approvals |>
  group_by(firm, atc_level1, post) |>
  summarise(any_innov = max(approvals > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(firm, post) |>
  summarise(
    n_atc_innov = sum(any_innov),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot: FDA
ggplot(fda_firm_atc_prepost, aes(x = n_atc_innov)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ post, labeller = as_labeller(c(`FALSE` = "Pre (≤2013)", `TRUE` = "Post (≥2014)"))) +
  labs(
    title = "FDA approvals: number of ATC1 classes with innovation (by firm)",
    x = "Number of ATC1 classes with ≥1 approval",
    y = "Number of firms"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

```


## Patents

```{r patents_between, message = FALSE}

patent_firm_atc_prepost <- patents |>
  group_by(firm, atc_level1, post) |>
  summarise(any_innov = max(patents > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(firm, post) |>
  summarise(
    n_atc_innov = sum(any_innov),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(patent_firm_atc_prepost, aes(x = n_atc_innov)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ post, labeller = as_labeller(c(`FALSE` = "Pre (≤2013)", `TRUE` = "Post (≥2014)"))) +
  labs(

    x = "Number of ATC1 classes with ≥1 patent",

```

# Within firm variation

## FDA

```{r FDA_within, message = FALSE}

#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

fda_firm_atc_counts <- fda_approvals |>
  group_by(firm, atc_level1, post) |>
  summarise(approvals = sum(approvals, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(approvals > 0)

fda_firm_index <- fda_firm_atc_counts |>
  group_by(firm) |>
  summarise(total_approvals = sum(approvals), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(total_approvals)) |>
  mutate(firm_id = row_number())


fda_plot_data <- fda_firm_atc_counts |>
  left_join(fda_firm_index, by = "firm") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = post, values_from = approvals, values_fill = 0) |>
  rename(pre = `FALSE`, post_val = `TRUE`)

atc_list_fda <- unique(fda_plot_data$atc_level1)

for (i in atc_list_fda) {
  
  # Filter for the ATC and apply the "Both > 5" rule
  single_atc_fda <- fda_plot_data |> 
    filter(atc_level1 == i) |>
    filter(pre >= 1 & post_val >= 1) # The Volume Filter
  
  # Skip the plot if no firms meet this strict criteria
  if(nrow(single_atc_fda) == 0) {
    cat("\n\n### ATC Level", i, ": No firms meet the >5 approvals threshold in both periods.\n\n")
    next
  }

  p <- ggplot(single_atc_fda, aes(x = firm_id)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = firm_id, y = pre, yend = post_val), 
                 color = "grey80", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = pre, color = "Pre (<=2013)"), size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(y = post_val, color = "Post (>=2014)"), size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Pre (<=2013)" = "#2c3e50", "Post (>=2014)" = "#e67e22")) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500)) + 
    labs(title = paste("FDA High-Volume Firms (>1): ATC Level", i),
         x = "Firm ID", y = "Approvals (log1p)", color = "Period") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
  
  print(p)

}

```


## Patents

```{r patents_within, message = FALSE}

#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

patent_firm_atc_counts <- patents |>
  group_by(firm, atc_level1, post) |>
  summarise(patents = sum(patents, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(patents > 0)

firm_index <- patent_firm_atc_counts |>
  group_by(firm) |>
  summarise(total_activity = sum(patents), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(total_activity)) |>
  mutate(firm_id = row_number())

patent_plot_data <- patent_firm_atc_counts |>
  left_join(firm_index, by = "firm") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = post, values_from = patents, values_fill = 0) |>
  rename(pre = `FALSE`, post_val = `TRUE`)

atc_list <- unique(patent_plot_data$atc_level1)


for (i in atc_list) {
  
  single_atc_data <- patent_plot_data |> 
    filter(atc_level1 == i) |>
    filter(pre >= 1 & post_val >= 1) # The Volume Filter

  if(nrow(single_atc_data) == 0) next

  p <- ggplot(single_atc_data, aes(x = firm_id)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = firm_id, y = pre, yend = post_val), 
                 color = "grey80", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = pre, color = "Pre (<=2013)"), size = 2, alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = post_val, color = "Post (>=2014)"), size = 2, alpha = 0.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Pre (<=2013)" = "#2980b9", "Post (>=2014)" = "#c0392b")) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 2000)) + 
    labs(title = paste("Patent High-Volume Firms (>1): ATC Level", i),
         x = "Firm ID", y = "Patents (log1p)", color = "Period") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
  
  print(p)

}

```

# Variance analysis

## FDA

```{r FDA_variance, message = FALSE}

fda_firm_atc_variance <- fda_plot_data |>
  # Pivot to long to get one row per firm-atc-period
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pre, post_val), names_to = "period", values_to = "count") |>
  group_by(firm, period) |>
  # Only keep firms active in more than 1 ATC in that period
  filter(n_distinct(atc_level1) > 1) |> 
  summarise(
    atc_variance = var(count),
    n_atcs = n_distinct(atc_level1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(atc_variance > 0)

# FDA Variance Distribution
ggplot(fda_firm_atc_variance, aes(x = atc_variance, fill = period)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Portfolio Variation: FDA Approvals (Across ATCs)",
    subtitle = "Higher variance = more 'uneven' innovation across therapeutic classes",
    x = "Variance across ATCs within a Firm",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_classic()




```


## Patents

```{r patents_variance, message = FALSE}

  pivot_longer(cols = c(pre, post_val), names_to = "period", values_to = "count") |>

  summarise(

  ) |>

# Patent Variance Distribution
ggplot(patent_firm_atc_variance, aes(x = atc_variance, fill = period)) +

```
